summary: Collect descriptors first, then define multiple properties using DefineProperties semantics.

semantics.descriptor_collection: all own keys (strings and Symbols) are visited in OwnPropertyKeys order; only enumerable descriptor-source properties are read and converted before definitions begin
semantics.definition_order: converted descriptor list is applied in key order

caveats: It is not equivalent to repeatedly calling a naive setter while reading descriptors because descriptor conversion happens first.
Symbol keys on the Properties object are valid property-definition keys and must not be dropped.

tests.name: defines multiple descriptors
tests.expected_behavior: keys contains only a; x.b is 2
